subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: After the cross-runtime instruction mismatch is repaired, should Codex `message_tool_only` completion permanently require explicit `final: true`, or retain implicit terminal source sends with prompt-only steering?
rationale: Both approaches fix the observed bug but create different model-facing completion and upgrade contracts, so repository history and tests cannot safely substitute for maintainer product intent.

options.title: Adopt explicit final intent
options.body: Keep the stronger runtime safeguard after every model-facing instruction and schema surface is consistently scoped to Codex.

options.title: Retain implicit completion
options.body: Choose the prompt-only alternative and preserve the existing confirmed-send terminal contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit final intent
recommendation.body: Keep the stronger runtime safeguard after every model-facing instruction and schema surface is consistently scoped to Codex.

likelyOwner.reason: His history most strongly spans the prompt policy and agent-runtime surfaces whose permanent contract must be chosen.
